name: LocalSendRT
author: fratta
description: LocalSendRT is a Win32/C client for LocalSend, made for RT devices. You can receive and send files between devices on the same network, fast and easy. You can also control this app directly only from the tray icon. This version, also, works with whatever other LocalSend client you have, including the official one.
instructionSteps: Remember that you need OpenSSL 3.x for RT
Run the LocalSendRT exe as Administrator to add the needed firewall rules
